tasks.note: merged; R1 APPROVED (IDOR structural, revokeDevice deferred+guardrailed); micro-fix: default consent channel MOBILE_APP->UNKNOWN (dont fabricate audit channel)
tasks.description:
Build the memberOAuth2-secured self-service endpoints for consents + device LISTING, reusing the auth foundation (Depends(get_current_member)) and the slice-1/2 repo/service/router/Error patterns. NO schema change (ConsentRecord + DeviceBinding models already exist). NO money/ledger.
READ: CLAUDE.md; the CONTRACT backend/openapi/paths/ep1-identity.yaml (listMyConsents, upsertMyConsent, listDevices) + schemas/ep1-identity.yaml (ConsentListResponse, ConsentUpsertRequest, ConsentRecord, ConsentType/Action, DeviceListResponse, Device, DevicePlatform); app/auth/deps.py (get_current_member); app/api/routers/members.py + app/services/profile.py (the established self-service pattern); app/models/identity.py (ConsentRecord, DeviceBinding + their enums).
IMPLEMENT to the EXACT contract schemas:
- listMyConsents (GET, 200 ConsentListResponse): the CURRENT member's consents only.
- upsertMyConsent (the contract's verb/path, ConsentUpsertRequest -> ConsentRecord): record a GRANTED/WITHDRAWN consent (consent_type, version, channel) for the CURRENT member; append-or-update per the contract's semantics (a ConsentRecord is an append-only audit row unless the schema says otherwise — follow the contract).
- listDevices (GET /api/v1/auth/devices, 200 DeviceListResponse): the CURRENT member's DeviceBindings only.
IDOR (the crux): identity comes ONLY from get_current_member; every query/mutation is filtered by the current member's id. NO member id from path/body. A member can never see or affect another member's consents/devices.
STEP-UP: check each operation's security in the contract. If an operation requires `stepUpAssertion` (e.g. revokeDevice — DELETE /auth/devices/{id}), DO NOT build it — step-up is a deferred slice. Build ONLY the memberOAuth2-only operations; note the deferred ones in the handoff. If upsertMyConsent requires step-up per the contract, defer it too and say so.
New app/repositories/identity.py (ConsentRepository, DeviceBindingRepository — get_by_member), app/services/identity.py (or per-domain services), routers wired into app/main.py. Repos flush-not-commit; router commits on mutation. Cyrillic-safe; no float; no first/last name.
Tests (TestClient, DevRsaSigner tokens for a seeded member, get_session overridden, no real DB): list returns only the caller's rows; upsert records for the caller and reflects on list; IDOR — a token for member A never returns/affects member B's consents or devices; no-token -> 401.
GATES from backend/ ALL PASS (paste in handoff): check_models, check_migration, openapi/validate.py, pytest; ruff+mypy strict clean on new files. Handoff: each endpoint's contract-conformance, the IDOR safeguard, which ops were DEFERRED for step-up and why, gate outputs verbatim.

Reason/probe: can a token for member A list or mutate member B's consents/devices? Confirm the A<->B isolation tests are NON-VACUOUS (B seeded with distinct rows; A's action never touches them). Any cross-member access = REJECT. (2) CONTRACT conformance: listMyConsents/upsertMyConsent/listDevices match the schemas (fields, enums, 200); consent audit semantics per the contract. (3) STEP-UP: confirm the author correctly DEFERRED any stepUpAssertion-gated op (revokeDevice at minimum) rather than building it without step-up — building a step-up-gated op without enforcing step-up is a security finding. (4) non-negotiables (no money/ledger/float, no first/last name, Cyrillic-safe); reuses foundation; repos flush-not-commit. Verdict APPROVED/MICRO-FIX/REJECTED with gate verdicts + the IDOR result + which ops were deferred.
